discussion_comments.comment_body: Same loopback nuance: the dashboard (localhost) and the popup callback (127.0.0.1) are different origins by design, so ev.origin !== window.location.origin would reject the legitimate message. Fixed in 6ff3238e8 — the listener now accepts that known loopback origin pair and strictly requires a matching loginTraceId (kept your strict-traceId tightening — good catch).
